<!-- Release: v0.12.3 -->

Development APK for Android 8 or newer. Signed with the project development key; updates the existing `.debug` app in place. Production distribution signing is not configured.

## Changes

- Customize Library filters, their order, and All’s collections; sort by added/modified dates and new local listening counts
- Search individual lists from slim floating pills and scoped popups, preserving the original list and result positions
- Clarify queue headers and numbered selectors, highlight selected options, and choose gallery items per row
- Share repeat/shuffle across queues with visible mode indicators; add persistent queue-order randomization
- Refine player artwork, matte texture, metadata/slider order, and collapse transitions; pull down from the queue’s top to close it
- Publish verified APKs without repeating the full test matrix for release tags

## Resolved issues

- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/42 - Reliable return-to-top after restoring a collection
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/43 - Configurable collections and durable date/play-count sorting
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/44 - Compact list-search pills and popups
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/45 - Clean backgrounds and artwork during player collapse
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/46 - Queue dismissal from its scrolling content
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/47 - Device-test synchronization with lists and system windows
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/48 - Clearer covers, subtler texture, and consistent player control order
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/49 - Global playback modes and saved queue randomization
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/50 - Numbered queue selector and direct queue controls
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/51 - Clear selections and animated sort direction
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/52 - Exact gallery column counts
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/53 - Unified mini-player taps and rounded press feedback
- https://github.com/anastaci1a/localica/issues/56 - Reuse verified artifacts and checks for releases

## Install

1. Download `localica-v0.12.3-debug.apk` from **Assets** below.
2. Open it and allow installation from your browser or file manager if prompted.
3. Install over your existing development app to keep its data.
